notes: The most consequential under-grading in the suite. A 1000x error in a money conversion was graded MINOR because the pre-change rule set found the one thing it was written to find — floats in arithmetic — and stopped. The scale disagreement and the truncating cast were both invisible, and both are larger errors than the float.
